t: You're looking at the statue of Thierry Henry, outside Emirates Stadium. It depicts the French footballer, who later became a manager and pundit. He's widely regarded as one of the greatest players in Premier League history, known for his speed, technical ability, composure and finesse shots, as well as his tactical intelligence. A statue like this is how a club chooses to mark a player who mattered to it, and fans pass it on their way to the ground.
